**Verdict: The ALLPOWERS S2000 Pro solar generator kit is worth buying for occasional camping, RV use, and emergency backup—but it's not my first choice for daily use or long-term home backup.**

The biggest advantage is its high 2,400W output at a relatively affordable price. The biggest drawback is that it uses an **NMC lithium battery, not LiFePO4**, which matters for battery longevity.

## Is it good value?

<box gap={3}>
  <row align="start" gap={2}>
    <icon name="check-circle" color="success"/>
    <box flex="1" gap={1}>
      **Excellent output for the money**

      A 2,400W inverter can handle many appliances and tools. At $866.70 including a 400W panel, the kit offers strong power-per-dollar value.
    </box>
  </row>
  <row align="start" gap={2}>
    <icon name="check-circle" color="success"/>
    <box flex="1" gap={1}>
      **Useful for occasional emergencies**

      The 1,451Wh battery could run a 100W load for roughly 12 hours after allowing for conversion losses. Actual runtime depends on the device and conditions.
    </box>
  </row>
  <row align="start" gap={2}>
    <icon name="alert-triangle" color="secondary"/>
    <box flex="1" gap={1}>
      **NMC rather than LiFePO4**

      NMC generally offers fewer full charge cycles than modern LiFePO4 batteries. That makes the S2000 Pro less attractive for frequent cycling over many years.
    </box>
  </row>
  <row align="start" gap={2}>
    <icon name="alert-triangle" color="secondary"/>
    <box flex="1" gap={1}>
      **Limited energy storage relative to output**

      Although it can supply 2,400W, the battery would last only around 30–35 minutes at that continuous load after typical losses.
    </box>
  </row>
</box>

An independent review aggregator, GearRanking, rates the S2000 Pro **4.1/5**, recommending it mainly for occasional use rather than daily cycling. <Cite refs={["turn351280view0"]}/>

| Emergency power a few times a year | Good value |
| Frequent off-grid use | Prefer LiFePO4 |
| Daily solar charging/discharging | Prefer LiFePO4 |
| Long-duration home backup | Look for greater battery capacity |

**My pick:** If you want an affordable, high-output solar generator with a substantial included panel, buy the S2000 Pro kit directly from [ALLPOWERS](https://iallpowers.com/products/allpowers-solar-generator-kit-2400w-s2000-pro-sp037-400w-solar-panel) using `ALLPOWERS26`, provided the discount still applies.

If you're planning to use it every day or keep it for many years, I'd spend the extra money on a LiFePO4 model such as the BLUETTI.
